_note: An allowance paid in money with the salary. In the four salary bases only where the employment's terms provide for it — S4 r.279(2)(b); S2 s.19(2)(b), s.124(13)(b), Sch. XV para 1(y); 1961 Sch. IV Pt A r.2(h), s.80CCD Expl. (D-092). Salary under the head: S2 s.16 (pp.37–38) "'salary' includes— (a) wages; … (d) any fees or commission; … (f) profits in lieu of, or in addition to, any salary or wages"; TY 2025-26 1961 s.17(1) (thc p.140) "(i) wages; … (iv) any fees, commissions, perquisites or profits in lieu of or in addition to any salary or wages". Which clause covers an allowance is not settled by the words; the engine reads only the head and feedsInto, so nothing turns on it. CASH: paid in money (DR 05 M2).
